### Major Realities of Life, Part One
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/major-realities-of-life-part-one
Passage: Ecclesiastes 9:1-2
Points:
- Solomon pivots from exploring life's vanity to focusing on foundational truths that provide substance and purpose.
- The sovereign hand of God rests over all people, regardless of their background, status, or intelligence.
- Resting in God's hands does not promise material wealth, good health, or an easy life free from suffering.
- Unpredictable circumstances can bring either love or hatred, yet believers can trust that God never loses control.
- Physical death is an absolute certainty that inevitably awaits both the righteous and the unrighteous.

### Least Within or Greatest Without - Truth For Life - September 30
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-september-30-2020.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 9:4
Points:
- Life in its humblest form remains far more valuable than death, particularly in the spiritual realm.
- Having even the smallest measure of genuine spiritual life exceeds the highest achievements of worldly culture.
- A simple, plain gospel message delivered with spiritual unction is far better than an eloquent speech devoid of power.
- Sincere sighs and cries quickened by the Spirit are acceptable to God, unlike grand outward religious performances.
- A struggling yet living faith is infinitely preferable to dead religion and empty profession.
